stages.1: One-cell separate fence and south gate around the reserved footprint.
stages.2: Same fence and foundation with compact crane, cabin and materials composed inside the footprint.
stages.3: Half assembled structure: unchanged full physical and projected envelope, unfinished masonry and open opaque rooms, no roof. Progress must not rescale the image.
stages.4: Same shell and front entrance, unfinished dark windows, roughly half the roof fitted, no finished rooftop equipment.
stages.5: Finished three-storey red/cream/teal apartment with a roof-dominant high frontal-top camera.

overrides: The user's compact-city redesign supersedes the legacy 18x14 lot, 8x16 door, shallow roof and stage-3 silhouette-height ratio. Assembly progress is semantic: removing a roof must not shrink the physical footprint or projected interior depth.
normalization: One common aspect-preserving source frame derived from stage 5; identical transform for all stages; nearest-neighbour scaling, hard alpha and palette quantization only. Never redraw geometry, warp axes, or independently recenter a reverse stage.
